canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for industrials/construction: catalog.py's 'industrial_construction' GROUPS entry only defines industrial_operations KPI fields, with no distinct sector-specific statement template.

project_backlog is this sector's single most-cited forward-looking metric and is also the field most prone to double counting (awarded but not yet executed contracts vs. recognized-but-unbilled backlog). This pack requires both project_backlog (total awarded, undelivered) and recognized_backlog/remaining_backlog as distinct catalog fields rather than treating 'backlog' as one ambiguous number, matching this project's general rule against collapsing distinct disclosed figures into a single field.

bid_success_rate and bid_pipeline_value are rarely disclosed by publicly listed contractors (treated as commercially sensitive); a genuine absence here is the expected steady state for this sector and resolves as unavailable (not_disclosed), not a sign of extraction failure.
